0.original: Maru looks genuinely worried.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

26.original: Return the fallen cargo within the time limit.

48.original: We might have trouble, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─one of our Riders has gone missin'.

49.original: Last we heard from him, he was headin' back here from Palaka's Stand, but that was some time ago.

50.original: You think you could spare a moment to join our search? We've covered the ground between here and the Wakeful Torana so far, but beyond that...

51.original: Oh, blessed be! Someone came lookin'!

52.original: You won't believe the beast we just ran into. Ugliest thing I've seen since the Final Days...

53.original: Well, we spanked away like our skins depended on it, but my delivery got jostled outta the cart.

54.original: To make matters worse, when I pull 'round to fetch it, my wheel slams into a rock, an' now I'm spinnin' six ways to nowhere!

55.original: My girl was in hippo hysterics─I had to cut her loose to stop her bellowin'. I hate to put you out like this, but you think you could lend me a hand an' bring me my cargo?

56.original: It's just one wooden crate. I think I spotted it by that boulder over there.

57.original: Shapin' up to be one of those days, I'm afraid─but knowin' that cargo's safe would make all the difference.

58.original: Return the fallen cargo to the harried Rider's cart before your arms give out.

59.original: You will have three minutes to complete the task. Should you fail, return to the starting location and begin anew.

60.original: That's it! Thank the Sisters. And you!

61.original: I'll head home as soon as we're ready to ride. Let Maru know we're alright, will you?

62.original: I've still gotta check the cart an' coax my girl back under the yoke─tell Maru we'll be on our way shortly, yeah?

63.original: So that's what happened! Thank the Sisters that everyone's alright...

64.original: Our Riders are usually pretty good at avoidin' the nastier beasties, but a jungle's still a jungle... Sounds like our carts could use some adjustments, too...

65.original: Anyroad, I'll mention it to the boss. Thanks for bein' a pal, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.
